scene_description: A surreal, high-octane cinematic concept art piece featuring a male athlete sprinting through a desert, pursued by a colossal, elemental cheetah formed entirely from swirling sand and dust.

features.expression: intense focus, determination, mouth slightly open in exertion

subject.attire: light grey athletic t-shirt with a subtle white logo on the chest, matching athletic shorts, running cap or close-cropped hair
subject.position: mid-stride sprinting across a sand dune, leaning forward into the run

action.secondary: kicking up a trail of dust and sand with every step
action.effect: the motion creates a connection between the runner and the giant sand creature behind him

environment.setting: vast, sun-drenched desert dunes under a partly cloudy sky
background_elements: deep blue sky with white cumulus clouds

visual_description.core_subject: A gigantic, hyper-realistic cheetah head and front paw emerging from a massive sandstorm.
visual_description.creature_physics: The cheetah is not solid; it is a volumetric simulation composed of millions of sand grains, dust, and wind. The edges of the fur dissolve into the sandstorm.
visual_description.scale: The cheetah is kaiju-sized, dwarfing the human runner, symbolizing speed and nature's power.

illuminates: the textured ridges of the sand-cheetah's face

lighting.shadows: Deep, sharp shadows casting definition on the sand ripples and the athlete's muscles

style.details: Grainy texture of sand, subsurface scattering in the dust clouds

scene_composition.subject_action: Dynamic movement from left to right
scene_composition.camera_behavior: Low angle, wide lens to emphasize the massive scale of the sand creature
scene_composition.depth_layering: Foreground runner -> Mid-ground Sand Cheetah -> Background Sky

lighting_and_atmosphere.specifics: Atmospheric haze caused by the sandstorm, sun flares peaking through clouds
lighting_and_atmosphere.color_grade: Desaturated blues, rich earthy beiges and tans, high contrast

attire_customization.customizable_clothing: User can replace with specific sportswear brand kits or colors

brand_product_customization.product_placement_area: Center chest of the t-shirt or the side of the shoes

camera_and_lens.aperture_effect: f/8 (deep depth of field to keep both subjects relatively sharp)
